description.ja: 「30 MINUTES SISTERS」シリーズに新たなシスター「30MS SIS-N00 ソウレイ[カラーB]」が登場！
description.en: A new sister "30MS SIS-N00 Sourei [Color B]" is now available in the " 30 MINUTES SISTERS" series!

description.ja: • キャラクター素体、タンポ印刷を施した3種類の表情パーツ、鎧パーツがセット。
description.en: • Set includes character body, 3 types of facial parts with tampo printing, and armor parts.

description.ja: • 「カラーB」のフェイスパーツにはタンポ印刷を採用。「通常」「照れ」「叫び」の3種からポージングに合わせた表情の付け替えを楽しめる。
description.en: • "Color B " face parts use tampo printing. You can enjoy changing the expression according to the pose from three types: " normal ", " embarrassed " and " screaming".

description.ja: • ヘアスタイルパーツは、パーツ分割により2色の髪色を表現。前髪はパーツの差し替えにより角パーツの有り無しを表現できる。
description.en: • Hair style parts express two different hair colors by dividing the parts. The bangs can be expressed with or without horn parts by replacing parts.

description.ja: • 歯のパーツを分割して構成、取り付けは選択式。
description.en: • The tooth parts are divided into parts, and installation is selective.

description.ja: • 両肩、背中には鎧を装着、右肩の「鬼の面」は顎パーツが可動。
description.en: • Armor is attached to both shoulders and back, and the jaw part of the "demon mask" on the right shoulder is movable.

description.ja: • 刀身や足に装着可能な炎エフェクトはクリアパーツで再現。
description.en: • The flame effect that can be attached to the blade and legs is reproduced with clear parts.

description.ja: • 刀身は2種類の異なる表面仕上げにより質感の違いを表現。鍔パーツは着脱可能。
description.en: • The blade has two different surface finishes to express different textures. Tsuba parts are removable.

description.ja: • 「30 MINUTES SISTERS」はフェイスパーツ/ヘアスタイルパーツ/ボディパーツを部位ごとにラインアップ展開。別売りのパーツと組み替えて自分好みのシスターを創ることができる。
description.en: • "30 MINUTES SISTERS" offers a lineup of face parts, hairstyle parts, and body parts by body part. You can create your own sister by combining parts sold separately.

description.ja: • 30 MINUTES LABEL共通の3mmジョイントを採用。「30 MINUTES MISSIONS」のパーツもオプションとして装着が可能。(※「30 MINUTES MISSIONS」キットの対象年齢は8才以上です)
description.en: • Adopts 3mm joint common to 30 MINUTES LABEL. "30 MINUTES MISSIONS " parts can also be installed as options. (*" 30 MINUTES MISSIONS" Kit is for ages 8 and up)
